items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: But his snare don't sound as good as Joe Jackson or somebody, you know.

ctx.x: I think some of the stuff I hear is like, I think some guys are tuning them like they're listening to a parade, you know, like the snares real raspy. Yeah. And the bass drum's real boom. Boom, boom, yeah.

Well, like I said, some guys play it tight. Some guys play it with the front head tight and the back head not, I mean, slightly loose, you know, where you get a thought, you know. But like I said, again, that's up to the individual. They all tune. Like I said, Idris Muhammad was here at Suno a few weeks ago. He tuned his different. And I was just watching him tune up, you know. Boom, boom, boom. He gets to the sound that he wants, you know. And the sound that he wants may not be the sound that I want. Or the…
Well, usually somebody said, yeah, the reason they sound so good is because of the way they got plays, not the way they tune them. Exactly, exactly, yeah.
